name: Privatzimmer Mairhofer
beschreibung:
History

A website of the house’s own that has been built out is the blog stored in the data set, urlaubebbs.blogspot.com. On retrieval only the line „Im Herzen von Ebbs“ and the notice „Keine Posts“ stood there. A founding history, a year of construction or the names of the hosts are therefore not documented. Herold lists the Gästehaus Mairhofer, Kaiserbergstraße 13, 6341 Ebbs, as a pension and private rooms, telephone +43 5373 43683. Gelbe Seiten Online repeats the address, the telephone number and the blog and lists the keywords breakfast and double bed. PocketAustria names the same street and the postcode 6340, that is a different postcode from Herold and the data set, both of which give 6341. Nearby entries on PocketAustria are the Café Dorfkind and the Kindergarten Ebbs. That is a neighbourhood statement by the directory, not a description of the house.

Getting there

The street that matches is Kaiserbergstraße 13 in Ebbs. PocketAustria names the bus stops Ebbs Schulzentrum at 264 metres, Ebbs Feuerwehr at 412 metres and Ebbs Freizeitzentrum at 778 metres. A line number or a timetable of the house is missing. Telephone according to Herold: +43 5373 43683.

Tips

Herold names breakfast as board and cash payment as the method of payment. Opening hours are not stored there. The number of rooms, prices, Wi-Fi or parking spaces do not appear on the pages named and are not invented. Older texts that claim a Tyrolean guest parlour, regional dishes or an inn business go beyond these sources. For an enquiry the telephone number remains. The empty blog does not currently confirm any additional services.
